name: craggy-fatestone-buff-counter-from-hand-materialize
notes:
Craggy Fatestone (h8n1520m2d): "Whenever an opponent materializes a card with memory cost 0, put a buff counter on Craggy Fatestone." Regression fixture for the FIX to the engine bug documented in craggy-fatestone-rest-transform-two-buff/meta.json: this clause was (a) wrongly gated behind IsGuoJiaBonus($opponent) -- that restriction only appears on the card's separate second [REST] transform clause -- and (b) only wired into DoMaterialize() (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php), which covers exclusively the rare from-material-zone/champion-lineage materialize path, so the trigger never fired for the overwhelmingly common case of an opponent materializing something from hand.

Fix: extracted the check into a shared CraggyFatestoneMaterializeTrigger($player, $memoryCost) helper (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php, defined just above DoMaterialize()) with the IsGuoJiaBonus gate removed, called from BOTH materialize chokepoints: DoMaterialize() (from-material-zone path, unchanged call site) and MoveEffectStackCardToField() (Custom/GameLogic.php, ~7474 -- the real from-hand-via-effect-stack chokepoint, which previously had no Craggy Fatestone check at all). These two call sites are mutually exclusive per materialize event (per the pre-existing telemetry comments at both -- confirmed by reading GameLogic.php's own comment: 'the two never overlap' -- predating this fix, from the Aug 24 2026 telemetry commit a5bc6aa5), so no double-fire guard was needed.

This fixture proves the FIXED from-hand path specifically, with NO Guo Jia Bonus active for either player (P1's champion is the plain starting Spirit of Fire): P1 controls Craggy Fatestone (seeded onto their field, buff counter left at its natural starting value of 0 -- NOT seeded). P2 has Fauna Friend (japulzj7gv, REGALIA,ITEM, reserve=-1/memory=0) seeded to their myHand-0 via patchMzId, because Regalia cards can never legitimately reach hand through AddHand() -- HandAddReplacement (GameLogic.php) redirects any freshly-'added' Regalia CardID straight into the Material zone instead (confirmed live via a direct BridgeAddToZone(..., 'myHand', 'japulzj7gv', 2) probe, which silently landed the card in Material, not Hand). Only Fauna Friend's presence in hand is synthetic -- the vehicle card, not the card under test. P1 then declines their turn-1 material-phase level-up prompt (mode 10001, myHealth-0!CustomInput!Pass), which auto-resolves the rest of their empty turn (this filler deck has no other legal action) and lands cleanly on P2's own turn 1 MAIN phase with zero pending decisions (verified live via RunnerPendingDecisionSummary). P2 then materializes Fauna Friend from myHand-0 via a single ordinary FSM action (mode 10002) -- memory cost 0 needs no MZCHOOSE/reserve decisions, so it resolves in one action straight onto P2's field.

Result, verified live: Craggy Fatestone's buff counter goes 0 -> 1 (Counters becomes {"buff":1}), unconditionally -- no Guo Jia Bonus champion on either side. Break/restore verified via `php DevTools/RunIntegrationTests.php --root=GrandArchiveSim --test=craggy-fatestone-buff-counter-from-hand-materialize --verbose`: temporarily deleting the CraggyFatestoneMaterializeTrigger() call from MoveEffectStackCardToField() (GameLogic.php, restoring the exact dead from-hand-path behavior) makes the fixture fail with 'Step 2 assertion failed: Expected myField-1.Counters to equal {"buff":1}, got []'; restoring that call makes it pass again (re-confirmed against the full 741-fixture suite, 741/741).

The existing craggy-fatestone-rest-transform-two-buff fixture is unaffected and still valid -- it covers the separate second [REST] transform clause (which correctly keeps its own IsGuoJiaBonus gate, untouched by this fix) and continues to seed its 2 buff counters directly via setProperties rather than this trigger.

rulesClauses: Whenever an opponent materializes a card with memory cost 0, put a buff counter on Craggy Fatestone.
